nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## Portraius Studio on your GPU: Recast

Recast on your GPU in two steps, as the app does it: Qwen draws the performer (Walt's full-body view) into the clip's first frame in the "Concert stage" preset's setting, then Wan Animate 2 moves that still through the clip, keeping the clip's sound. Put `walt-full-body.jpg`, `concert-original.webp` (the clip's first frame) and `concert-original.mp4` from `public/samples/` in `ComfyUI/input/`. Use a clip you filmed or have the rights to use.

**Inputs in `ComfyUI/input/`:** `walt-full-body.jpg`, `concert-original.webp`, `concert-original.mp4`. Samples are in this repo's `public/samples/`.

Free: open-weight models and ComfyUI's own nodes, so no account or credits. Built by the app's own local adapters from the request its studio makes, so it matches what "On your GPU" sends (docs/local-setup.md).

**Models (Qwen-Image-Edit 2511, Wan Animate 2).** Every file is Apache 2.0.

| Folder in `ComfyUI/models/` | File | GB |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `diffusion_models` | [qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors) | 20.5 |
| `text_encoders` | [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) | 9.4 |
| `vae` | [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors) | 0.3 |
| `loras` | [Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning/resolve/main/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors) | 0.9 |
| `diffusion_models` | [wan_animate_2_distill_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-Animate-2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/wan_animate_2_distill_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 16.7 |

| `clip_vision` | [clip_vision_h.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-Animate-2/resolve/main/clip_vision/clip_vision_h.safetensors) | 1.3 |

nodes.title: Text Encode Qwen Image Edit Plus
widgets_values: Image 1 is a full-body portrait of a person. Image 2 is the first frame of a video. Draw the person from image 1, with exactly the same face, hair, skin and build, in place of the person in image 2: in the same position, at the same size in the frame and in the same pose. About them: Retired harbour pilot. Tall and lean, usually in a navy wool peacoat over a dark knit sweater. Dress them as described there; anything it leaves out comes from image 1. The place is a large concert stage with crowd lights and haze behind, seen from the same camera position as image 2. Nobody else is in the picture. No text, signs or lettering.
